1	# QA calibration notes from independent evidence review
2	
3	These are harness checks, not permission to suppress genuine app failures. Reproduce before classifying.
4	
5	- The agreed mobile layout breakpoint is **below 768px**. 768px is a tablet/desktop layout even if the Playwright context hasTouch=true. Toast top-right at 768px is valid; do not force the app to use a phone layout just to satisfy an isMobile flag.
6	- Focus assertions must wait for CSS transitions/animation-frame styles to settle. A computed outline width with outline-style:none is not a visible ring; likewise rgba(...,0) zero-size box-shadow is not a visible ring. Compare stable focused/unfocused border or nontransparent shadow/outline, and confirm with screenshot. The saved Admin 360 input-focus screenshot visibly has a blue ring.
7	- The native Tab sequence can briefly return to document.body/browser chrome after the last focusable page element before wrapping. Do not invent tabindex/focus trapping for the whole page. Iterate the actual visible page focusable controls once in logical order. A **dialog**, however, must trap Tab/Shift+Tab, move focus inside, return focus and manage background scrolling.
8	- Mobile filter field widths should equal the **available parent content width**, not viewport width less a guessed constant. Admin filter fields are nested within a padded panel and a padded filter group. The Admin 360 populated screenshot shows full-width stacked fields within that actual content area.
9	- The semantic green text #15803D on #E7F5EC was measured at about 4.46:1. This is a genuine AA failure for normal-sized enabled text and must be corrected (e.g. darker semantic text or a lighter background); brand blue values should stay unchanged.
10	- Synthetic fixture login/storage/SignalR/polling behavior must match real source. Test failures caused by mismatched fixture IDs/properties/routes or accidentally modifying test setup every page load are harness defects. Never change product code solely to accommodate inaccurate fixtures.

# QA calibration notes from independent evidence review

These are harness checks, not permission to suppress genuine app failures. Reproduce before classifying.

- The agreed mobile layout breakpoint is **below 768px**. 768px is a tablet/desktop layout even if the Playwright context hasTouch=true. Toast top-right at 768px is valid; do not force the app to use a phone layout just to satisfy an isMobile flag.
- Focus assertions must wait for CSS transitions/animation-frame styles to settle. A computed outline width with outline-style:none is not a visible ring; likewise rgba(...,0) zero-size box-shadow is not a visible ring. Compare stable focused/unfocused border or nontransparent shadow/outline, and confirm with screenshot. The saved Admin 360 input-focus screenshot visibly has a blue ring.
- The native Tab sequence can briefly return to document.body/browser chrome after the last focusable page element before wrapping. Do not invent tabindex/focus trapping for the whole page. Iterate the actual visible page focusable controls once in logical order. A **dialog**, however, must trap Tab/Shift+Tab, move focus inside, return focus and manage background scrolling.
- Mobile filter field widths should equal the **available parent content width**, not viewport width less a guessed constant. Admin filter fields are nested within a padded panel and a padded filter group. The Admin 360 populated screenshot shows full-width stacked fields within that actual content area.
- The semantic green text #15803D on #E7F5EC was measured at about 4.46:1. This is a genuine AA failure for normal-sized enabled text and must be corrected (e.g. darker semantic text or a lighter background); brand blue values should stay unchanged.
- Synthetic fixture login/storage/SignalR/polling behavior must match real source. Test failures caused by mismatched fixture IDs/properties/routes or accidentally modifying test setup every page load are harness defects. Never change product code solely to accommodate inaccurate fixtures.

1	# AdminUI blue redesign - QA report
2	Date: 2026-10-14 · Tester: qa-tester (independent of frontend-engineer) · App code untouched, nothing staged/committed.
3	
4	## Result
5	**3 open reproducible bugs** (all Low/Medium, none block login or the approve flows). Builds green; 531/541 dev and 475/482 prod browser assertions pass, and every failing assertion maps to a bug below.
6	
7	## Commands and results
8	| Command | Result |
9	|---|---|
10	| `node node_modules/@angular/cli/bin/ng.js build --configuration development --output-path <temp>` | OK, no warnings (`qa/build-dev.log`) |
11	| `... build --configuration production --output-path <temp>` | OK, no warnings; main 411.86 kB / 106.60 kB transfer (`qa/build-prod.log`) |
12	| `node docs/design-blue/qa/harness.cjs dev` (ng serve, 127.0.0.1:4313, started and disposed by harness) | 541 assertions, 531 pass, 10 fail (9 = BUG-1, 1 = BUG-2) |
13	| `node docs/design-blue/qa/harness.cjs prod <tempdir>/prod` (static server of the production build) | 482 assertions, 475 pass, 7 fail (6 = BUG-1, 1 = BUG-2). The confirm-dialog block is dev-only (needs the `window.ng` debug API) so it is **not** run against prod |
14	| Grep of `src` for old brand hexes, `linear-gradient`, `z-index: 1000` | 0 matches |
15	
16	Console/network: dev 30 console errors, all from deliberately injected 400/409/500 fixture responses plus the app's own `console.error(err)`; 0 page errors, 0 unexpected. Prod: same, plus warnings "Service Worker registration blocked" that I caused (`serviceWorkers:'block'`). **0 remote requests reached the network** (all service-tokens.com `/api` calls fulfilled from fixtures; Google Fonts import stubbed; anything else would be aborted and logged — none occurred).
17	
18	Harness: `docs/design-blue/qa/harness.cjs` (dependency-free, isolated fresh browser context per scenario, synthetic data). Raw results: `docs/design-blue/results-dev.json`, `results-prod.json`; logs `qa/run-*.log`. Screenshots: `docs/design-blue/screenshots/<dev|prod>/AdminUI_<route>_<width>_<state>.png` (dev 54, prod 51; widths 360/768/1440).
19	
20	## States exercised (all at 360x800, 768x1024, 1440x1000)
21	- Routes: `/`→login, unknown→login, unauthenticated `/dashboard`→login (no API calls). Home component is **not routed** (`app.routes.ts`), so it could not be tested in the browser.
22	- Login: empty, input focus, loading (900 ms delayed login, button disabled), 400 error toast ("Invalid username or password."), retry success → dashboard (Login + GetById calls).
23	- Companies: populated (4 rows, long name), filters name/tax/status, filter no-results, Clear filter, approve success (PATCH url and params asserted, row flips to Active), approve 409 error toast, loading, empty, 500 error + Retry action → populated.
24	- Requests: populated (statuses Created/Authorised/Approved/None, null names/dates), status filter and Company-Id+Enter refetch params asserted, no-results, Clear/Refresh, approve success (POST asserted), approve 409, empty, 500 + Retry, short-data width probe.
25	- Confirm dialog (dev only, opened via Angular debug API because `deleteRequest()` has no button in the template): aria, initial focus, Tab trap, Escape, backdrop click, Delete → DELETE + toast, 360px stacking.
26	- Keyboard: tab order and visible focus indicator on tabs, filter controls, Approve, back link.
27	- Computed-style checks: blue/neutral tokens, solid blue primary with white text, radii 8/16, page bg #F4F7FB, panel gutters 16/24 px, no gradients, no purple/pink/cyan and no non-semantic green on any element, no text <12px, contrast AA (non-disabled), no clipped labels, no viewport horizontal overflow, controls >=44 px under a touch-pointer emulation, tables scroll only inside `.table-scroll`.
28	
29	## Bug ledger
30	| ID | Sev | Route / viewport / state | Expected | Actual | Owner |
31	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
32	| BUG-1 | Low | `/dashboard` Companies (Active) and Requests (Approved), all viewports, populated | `.status--ok` text >=4.5:1 (12px text) | `#15803D` on `#E7F5EC` measures 4.46:1 | frontend-engineer: `admin-dashboard.component.scss` `.status--ok` (and the same pair in the shared tokens: darken `$ok` text on `$ok-bg`, e.g. `#146C34`, or lighten `$ok-bg`) |
33	| BUG-2 | Medium | `/dashboard` Requests tab, 1440x1000, populated, even with short names (see `AdminUI_dashboard-requests_1440_short-data.png`) | Primary Approve action reachable without horizontal scroll at desktop | `.grid--wide` min-width 960 with `white-space: nowrap` gives table scrollWidth 1071 > wrapper 1028; the Actions column and Approve button are clipped (long data worse). No sticky Actions column or scroll cue. Also at 360/768 Approve is off-screen until scrolled (scrolling inside the wrapper is allowed by the brief, so only 1440 asserted) | frontend-engineer: `admin-dashboard.component.scss` (reduce date column width / drop nowrap on dates, or sticky last column) |
34	| BUG-3 | Low | Confirm dialog, all viewports (dev) | Brief/designer §4: focus returns to the invoking control on close | After Escape or backdrop close, `document.activeElement` is the app root, not the opener | frontend-engineer: `confirm-dialog.component.ts` (remember `document.activeElement` on open, restore on close) |
35	
36	Advisory (design-spec level, not asserted as failure): the shared focus ring `0 0 0 3px rgba(37,99,235,.35)` is the *only* focus indicator on buttons (border unchanged) and computes to about 1.7:1 against white, below the 3:1 non-text guidance; inputs are fine because the border also turns blue. Visible but low contrast. Owner: designer/frontend decision on `$focus-ring`.
37	
38	## Observations (not bugs / outside redesign scope)
39	- Delete request has no UI trigger (`deleteRequest()` unused in the template) and Company Approve has no confirmation; both pre-existing, the latter already listed in the implementation report.
40	- On 500 responses with an empty body the toast message is `undefined`/empty (`err.error?.message`); pre-existing logic, not styling.
41	- Desktop Approve buttons in tables are 36px high (spec permits 36px in dense tables; 44px is applied under coarse pointer).
42	- Login loading state is only a dimmed disabled button (no spinner/`is-loading`); the label stays "Login".
43	- Disabled Approve buttons use opacity .55 on a pale background and are faint; WCAG exempts disabled controls.
44	- Loading placeholder is plain "Loading..." text.
45	- API has no auth and the UI uses a production URL in `environment.ts`; backend/security items are out of scope here.
46	
47	## Harness notes (defects I fixed in my own tooling)
48	Headless Chrome does not emulate `(pointer: coarse)`, so for 360/768 contexts the harness rewrites that media query to always-true in the app's own served JS/CSS; the touch-target assertions therefore verify the app's coarse-pointer rules, not real touch hardware. The confirm dialog is opened by invoking the component method inside the captured Angular zone. Toast placement threshold is <768 = mobile (the app's breakpoint).
49	
50	## Unverified / not covered
51	- `home` component (not routed), real touch devices, real fonts (Google Fonts stubbed, so Inter fell back to the system stack), Safari/Firefox, screen readers, reduced-motion, high-zoom, dark mode.
52	- Dialog tests against the production build (needs a dev-only debug API).
53	- Service worker behaviour in prod (blocked).
54	- Pixel match to the concept reference (only a direction reference exists; not claimed).
55	- Dialog backdrop checks use fullPage screenshots, where the fixed overlay covers only the first viewport; this is a screenshot artifact.
56

- Requests: populated (statuses Created/Authorised/Approved/None, null names/dates), status filter and Company-Id+Enter refetch params asserted, no-results, Clear/Refresh, approve success (POST asserted), approve 409, empty, 500 + Retry, short-data width probe.
- Confirm dialog (dev only, opened via Angular debug API because `deleteRequest()` has no button in the template): aria, initial focus, Tab trap, Escape, backdrop click, Delete → DELETE + toast, 360px stacking.
- Keyboard: tab order and visible focus indicator on tabs, filter controls, Approve, back link.
- Computed-style checks: blue/neutral tokens, solid blue primary with white text, radii 8/16, page bg #F4F7FB, panel gutters 16/24 px, no gradients, no purple/pink/cyan and no non-semantic green on any element, no text <12px, contrast AA (non-disabled), no clipped labels, no viewport horizontal overflow, controls >=44 px under a touch-pointer emulation, tables scroll only inside `.table-scroll`.

## Bug ledger
| ID | Sev | Route / viewport / state | Expected | Actual | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| BUG-1 | Low | `/dashboard` Companies (Active) and Requests (Approved), all viewports, populated | `.status--ok` text >=4.5:1 (12px text) | `#15803D` on `#E7F5EC` measures 4.46:1 | frontend-engineer: `admin-dashboard.component.scss` `.status--ok` (and the same pair in the shared tokens: darken `$ok` text on `$ok-bg`, e.g. `#146C34`, or lighten `$ok-bg`) |
| BUG-2 | Medium | `/dashboard` Requests tab, 1440x1000, populated, even with short names (see `AdminUI_dashboard-requests_1440_short-data.png`) | Primary Approve action reachable without horizontal scroll at desktop | `.grid--wide` min-width 960 with `white-space: nowrap` gives table scrollWidth 1071 > wrapper 1028; the Actions column and Approve button are clipped (long data worse). No sticky Actions column or scroll cue. Also at 360/768 Approve is off-screen until scrolled (scrolling inside the wrapper is allowed by the brief, so only 1440 asserted) | frontend-engineer: `admin-dashboard.component.scss` (reduce date column width / drop nowrap on dates, or sticky last column) |
| BUG-3 | Low | Confirm dialog, all viewports (dev) | Brief/designer §4: focus returns to the invoking control on close | After Escape or backdrop close, `document.activeElement` is the app root, not the opener | frontend-engineer: `confirm-dialog.component.ts` (remember `document.activeElement` on open, restore on close) |

Advisory (design-spec level, not asserted as failure): the shared focus ring `0 0 0 3px rgba(37,99,235,.35)` is the *only* focus indicator on buttons (border unchanged) and computes to about 1.7:1 against white, below the 3:1 non-text guidance; inputs are fine because the border also turns blue. Visible but low contrast. Owner: designer/frontend decision on `$focus-ring`.

## Observations (not bugs / outside redesign scope)
- Delete request has no UI trigger (`deleteRequest()` unused in the template) and Company Approve has no confirmation; both pre-existing, the latter already listed in the implementation report.
- On 500 responses with an empty body the toast message is `undefined`/empty (`err.error?.message`); pre-existing logic, not styling.
- Desktop Approve buttons in tables are 36px high (spec permits 36px in dense tables; 44px is applied under coarse pointer).
- Login loading state is only a dimmed disabled button (no spinner/`is-loading`); the label stays "Login".
- Disabled Approve buttons use opacity .55 on a pale background and are faint; WCAG exempts disabled controls.
- Loading placeholder is plain "Loading..." text.
- API has no auth and the UI uses a production URL in `environment.ts`; backend/security items are out of scope here.

## Harness notes (defects I fixed in my own tooling)
Headless Chrome does not emulate `(pointer: coarse)`, so for 360/768 contexts the harness rewrites that media query to always-true in the app's own served JS/CSS; the touch-target assertions therefore verify the app's coarse-pointer rules, not real touch hardware. The confirm dialog is opened by invoking the component method inside the captured Angular zone. Toast placement threshold is <768 = mobile (the app's breakpoint).

## Unverified / not covered
- `home` component (not routed), real touch devices, real fonts (Google Fonts stubbed, so Inter fell back to the system stack), Safari/Firefox, screen readers, reduced-motion, high-zoom, dark mode.
- Dialog tests against the production build (needs a dev-only debug API).
- Service worker behaviour in prod (blocked).
- Pixel match to the concept reference (only a direction reference exists; not claimed).
- Dialog backdrop checks use fullPage screenshots, where the fixed overlay covers only the first viewport; this is a screenshot artifact.

Independent screenshot review (`investor_marketplace-primary_1440_populated.png`) also shows excessively stretched vertical spacing inside card metadata, and outlined add-to-cart actions where the selected concept uses a solid blue primary action. ## CompanyUI and InvestorUI: custom dialog keyboard/focus/scroll gaps

Company's report explicitly says custom dashboard and scanner dialogs do not move focus or lock background scrolling. Investor's report leaves QR Escape/focus-return behavior unverified and only adds Escape for marketplace details. The designer's dialog rules require focus entry, keyboard containment, Escape/backdrop handling (unless submitting), focus return and background scroll locking. Verify and fix existing custom dialogs in all apps as needed, using a shared helper where it avoids duplicated logic. Avoid changing business submission/camera/SignalR behavior.
